description: Explain one yof rule in plain words: what it means, why it matters, how urgent it is and the safe fix. Use it to understand a finding from yof_check, yof_check_diff or yof_findings; use yof_fix_prompt instead for step-by-step instructions for one specific finding. Key rules (secret.*) and package rules (package.*) are answered on this computer without reading project files; any other rule id is asked of yof.io only when YOF_API_KEY is set, and is an error otherwise. Returns rule, name (or title from yof.io), severity, why and safe_fix.

rule_id.description: The rule id exactly as a finding shows it, for example secret.stripe_live or package.made_up.

name: yof_explain

name.description: Readable rule name (rules answered on this computer).

safe_fix.description: The safe way to fix it.

standards.description: CWE and OWASP references (rules answered by yof.io).

title.description: Readable rule name (rules answered by yof.io).

title: Explain a finding
